veranderings.rede: 'weggeraak' mostly means 'got lost'; 'verdwyn' says plainly that the plants disappear, and it reads more naturally after 'verrot'.

veranderings.voor: Eers kook die hitte van brandende steenkool die water tot stoom.
veranderings.na: Eers verander die hitte van brandende steenkool water in stoom.
veranderings.rede: 'kook ... tot stoom' is wooden; 'verander ... in stoom' is the natural Afrikaans, and 'die water' has no earlier mention to refer back to.

veranderings.blok: Jou TV se energie, teruggevolg na die Son
veranderings.voor: Die hitte wat die water tot stoom kook
veranderings.na: Die hitte wat die water in stoom verander
veranderings.rede: Same wooden 'tot stoom kook' as in the power-station block; 'in stoom verander' is natural and keeps the two blocks matching.

veranderings.voor: wat om die hele Aarde loop
veranderings.rede: A layer does not 'loop' around something; 'bedek' is the natural verb for a layer covering the Earth.
